_comment: Verified ticker transitions. Ordinary renames carry earnings history to the current symbol. A transition with history_policy=preserve_pre_transition and price_history_continuous=false retains pre-transition earnings and market observations under the original symbol; only earnings on/after renamed_on use the successor. Identity continuity does not establish price comparability across a spin-off. Distinct from delisted_tickers.json, which removes companies that stopped trading entirely. Loaded via scripts/delisted.py.

MSGS.reason: Madison Square Garden Sports completed the Rangers spin-off at 11:59 p.m. ET on October 26, 2026. The continuing parent became MSG Knickerbockers Corp., trading as MSGK on October 27 with unchanged parent CUSIP 55825T103. Shareholders received one share of independent MSG Rangers Corp. (MSGR) per two parent shares. MSGE is the separate Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp.; neither MSGR nor MSGE is a rename target. Retain pre-spin earnings as MSGS and do not splice raw prices across the distribution.

LEG.reason: Somnigroup International completed its all-stock combination with Leggett & Platt; NYSE ticker LEG ceased trading and the business continues under NYSE: SGI.

ASGN.reason: ASGN rebranded to Everforth, Inc.; NYSE ticker ASGN -> EFOR.

FDP.reason: Ticker symbol change FDP -> DMC; same company, earnings history carried over.

SATS.reason: EchoStar Corporation changed its Nasdaq ticker SATS -> ECHO; not a delisting. Reclassified from config/delisted_tickers.json so earnings history carries over.

PSKY.reason: Paramount Skydance Corporation changed its name to Skydance Corporation and transferred its Class B common stock from Nasdaq to NYSE; PSKY -> SKYD is the same issuer, not a delisting.
